title: Partner hubs
footer: Your assistant can send messages to the assistant of a hub paired here, and get its answers. Nothing else is shared: no chats, files or computers.
empty: Pair with another hub, and your assistant can send messages to its assistant.
no_issue: Other hubs can't reach this one over a secure connection, so it can't show a code. Show the code on the other hub and pair from here.
member: This hub is part of a linked-hubs group, so it can't pair with partner hubs.
off: Partner hubs are turned off on this hub.
waits_for_it: Waiting for it to connect to this hub
confirm_hint: Your assistant's messages to this hub wait for your OK
dial_hint: Turn it off when that hub can't be reached from here: this hub then waits for it to connect
code_note: On the other hub, open Settings › This hub › Partner hubs, choose Pair… and paste it. It works once.
code_warning: Whoever has this code can pair their hub with this one. Only give it to people you trust.
name: Name
code_hint: Make it on the other hub with Show my code. It works once, for 10 minutes.
not_a_code: This isn't a partner hub code. It starts with persona://partner
check_fp: Check that this fingerprint matches the one the other hub shows with its code.
err_off: Partner hubs are turned off on this hub.
err_other_off: The other hub has partner hubs turned off. Turn them on there, then pair again.
err_member: This hub is part of a linked-hubs group, so it can't pair with partner hubs.
err_no_tls: Other hubs can't reach this one over a secure connection, so it can't make a code. Show the code on the other hub instead.
err_own_code: That's this hub's own code. Paste the code from the other hub.
err_already_linked: That hub is already linked with this one in a linked-hubs group.
err_pin_changed: That hub's fingerprint has changed since you paired. Unpair it first, then pair again with a new code.
err_code_refused: The other hub refused this code: it was already used or has expired. Make a new one there.
err_bad_code: This code can't be read. Copy it again from the other hub.
err_unreachable: Couldn't reach the other hub. Check that it's running and can be reached from this one, then try again.
err_unreachable_detail: Couldn't reach the other hub ({detail}). Check that it's running and can be reached from this one, then try again.
